rows.note: This is the default choice for an institutional canteen at a school, workplace, or military base.

example.english: We have breakfast in the school canteen.
example.traditional: 我哋朝早喺學校飯堂食早餐。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ziu1 zou2 hai2 hok6 haau6 faan6 tong4 sik6 zou2 caan1

rows.note: Use this when the canteen is being viewed as a cafeteria or dining room rather than specifically as an institutional facility.

example.english: There are lots of people in this canteen at lunchtime.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳午飯時間好多人。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ng5 faan6 si4 gaan1 hou2 do1 jan4

rows.note: Use this for a school or workplace snack bar selling light food and drinks.

example.english: I go to the school canteen to buy an iced lemon tea after school.
example.traditional: 放學後我去小食部買杯凍檸茶。
example.jyutping: fong3 hok6 hau6 ngo5 heoi3 siu2 sik6 bou6 maai5 bui1 dung3 ling4 caa4

rows.note: Use this for the portable flask or water container carried by a soldier or camper.

example.english: Remember to bring your canteen when you go hiking.
example.jyutping: haang4 saan1 gei3 dak1 daai3 maai4 seoi2 wu4
